title: Mongo-sharded: cert-rotate is N/A in v1 (graceful)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate mongo-sharded`. The 0.N v1 sharded cluster authenticates with a shared keyFile and runs WITHOUT TLS (mTLS is the deferred 0.N.1 hardening, ADR-0040), so cert-rotate returns a clear, actionable not-applicable result rather than failing obscurely.

observe.what: graceful failure: explains no TLS in v1, points to the 0.N.1 mTLS hardening + the keyFile-rotation path

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.RotateCertAsync returns a graceful, actionable not-applicable Result (like the deferred Kafka verbs) — never a silent or obscure failure — reflecting the live no-TLS contract.
